metadata.report_title: Veralogix Group — Cross-Portfolio Tender Monitoring Intelligence
metadata.scope: South African national, parastatal, mining house, and municipal tender landscape
metadata.purpose: Foundation dataset for Geologix Vanguard tender monitoring database

national_portals.description: The official single national platform for all public sector tender notices across all government departments, provinces, municipalities, and most SOEs. Mandatory publication point for competitive bids.
national_portals.update_frequency: Daily — new tenders published continuously by procuring entities
registration_requirements: Free to browse and download tender documents — no registration required to view
CSD (Central Supplier Database) registration at csd.gov.za is required to respond to tenders
CSD registration requires: Company registration (CIPC), SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS PIN), BBBEE certificate, banking details

data_format.bulk_download: OCDS-compliant CSV, JSON, and Excel — monthly bulk files from May 2021 available at data.etenders.gov.za
data_format.api: JSON REST API (OCDS standard) — public, no auth required, documented at ocds-api.etenders.gov.za/swagger/index.html
data_format.scrape_status: Portal is HTML-only for individual notices; bulk data preferred via OCDS API

veralogix_group_relevance.all_divisions: Primary tender publication point — all six group entities should monitor this daily

national_portals.notes: OCDS API is the most efficient programmatic access method. Apify has a ready-built South Africa eTender scraper (apify.com/fortuitous_pirate/southafrica-etender-scraper) if scraping individual notices is needed.

national_portals.description: Statutory body regulating construction contractors. All public-sector clients must use the CIDB Register of Contractors for construction procurement. Grades 1–9 determine maximum contract value and works category.
national_portals.update_frequency: Contractor register: continuously updated. Tender notices: published via eTenders and CIDB's own platform.
registration_requirements: CIDB Grade 1: R450/class of works, no track record required, valid 3 years. Activated within 48 hours.
CIDB Grades 2–9: Progressive financial and track record requirements; 21 working days processing
Five classes of works: CE (Civil Engineering), GB (General Building), ME (Mechanical), EP (Electrical Infrastructure), EB (Electrical Building)
Requires: SARS TCS PIN (eFiling), CIPC company registration, BBBEE certificate
Annual update required within 3-year validity period; suspension after 2 consecutive missed updates

data_format.contractor_register_api: REST API available for contractor verification lookups
data_format.bulk_download: Not available for tender notices; contractor register is queryable
data_format.scrape_status: Scrape-feasible for tender notices; API preferred for contractor register

required_for: Veralift Crane Hire (CE class for crane hire on construction sites)
recommended_for: Mining Safety Services (construction-phase safety on surface projects)

national_portals.notes: Endeto and Veralift must hold appropriate CIDB grades to respond to public infrastructure construction tenders. Grade determines maximum tender value eligibility.

national_portals.description: State-owned electricity utility managing 95% of SA's power generation. Runs its own e-tendering system separate from the national eTenders portal. Major procurement spender — significant infrastructure, maintenance, and service contracts.
national_portals.update_frequency: Weekly tender bulletin; individual tenders published on rolling basis
registration_requirements: Step 1: CSD registration (mandatory prerequisite)
Step 2: Eskom vendor database registration (online form + physical/email submission option)
Required documents: Company registration, SARS tax clearance, BBBEE certificate, business profile
Processing time: 4–6 weeks from complete submission
Annual update of returnable documentation required

data_format.primary: HTML tender bulletin + PDF tender documents
data_format.e_tendering: Web-based e-tendering system for formal tenders
data_format.api: No public procurement API; Eskom Data Portal (eskom.co.za/dataportal) covers operational data only
data_format.scrape_status: Tender bulletin (tenderbulletin.eskom.co.za) is HTML-searchable; also published via eTenders for some categories

high_value_for: Endeto Project Services (plant maintenance, shutdown work)
Veralift Crane Hire (heavy lift on power stations)
Mining Safety Services (SHE services at power station construction sites)
veralogix_group_relevance.coal_procurement: Eskom is the largest single buyer of South African thermal coal — Coal Processors International indirectly relevant through coal mine safety and plant services

national_portals.notes: Eskom had 159 cancelled tenders in 2025 (high cancellation rate — monitor closely for reissues). Major spender on infrastructure rehabilitation, solar projects, and coal supply chain services.

national_portals.description: State-owned freight logistics and ports utility. Manages rail, ports, pipelines. Major buyer of engineering services, maintenance, ICT, equipment, and construction.
national_portals.update_frequency: Continuous via eSupplier portal; also published on eTenders for certain categories
registration_requirements: CSD registration mandatory prerequisite
Transnet eSupplier portal registration (esupplierportal.transnet.net)
Vendor application form authorized by Procurement Manager — only after award or RFQ invitation
Must respond to open tenders or calls for quotes first, then vendor registration follows
Transnet Enterprise & Supplier Development (ESD) programme available for SMME suppliers

data_format.primary: HTML web portal (Transnet Tenders page) + eSupplier portal
data_format.scrape_status: HTML-scrape feasible; some tenders also appear on eTenders portal

high_value_for: Endeto Project Services (rail engineering, port maintenance)
Veralift Crane Hire (heavy lifting at port and terminal facilities)
moderate_for: Veralogix Rentals (equipment hire for Transnet construction)

national_portals.notes: Transnet had 129 cancelled tenders in 2025 — verify tender status before investing bid resources. New eSupplier Portal launched for seamless digital experience.

national_portals.portal_name: DMRE (Department of Mineral Resources and Energy) Procurement
national_portals.description: DMRE direct procurement notices for services related to mine health and safety, regulatory inspection support, ICT, and departmental operations.
national_portals.update_frequency: Irregular — major tenders published on eTenders; departmental procurement notices on DMRE site
registration_requirements: CSD registration mandatory
BBBEE certificate
Specific technical accreditations for mine safety and health services

data_format.api: No public API; DMRE is a contributor to the national eTenders OCDS dataset
data_format.scrape_status: HTML-scrape feasible; most tenders also appear on eTenders

primary_for: Mining Safety Services (inspector training, compliance systems, safety advisory)

national_portals.notes: DMRE also funds the MHSC (mhsc.org.za/open-tenders/) which runs its own procurement for OHS research, training content, and advisory services — separate and important tender source for Mining Safety Services.

national_portals.description: State defence procurement entity. Manages acquisition of armaments, defence equipment, and related services for the SA National Defence Force.
national_portals.update_frequency: Irregular — tenders published as required; monitored via Armscor website and eTenders
registration_requirements: Armscor Supplier & Security Registration (separate from CSD — includes security vetting)
CSD registration also required
Security clearance may be required for classified procurement categories

veralogix_group_relevance.limited_relevance: Primarily relevant if Veralogix Group has a security services or guarding division
potential_for: Veramani IT (if providing ICT to SANDF facilities)
Endeto Project Services (if providing maintenance to defence installations)

national_portals.notes: Security vetting requirement creates a significant barrier to entry. Relevant primarily if the group has or acquires a security services division.

national_portals.description: State entity managing the national road network. Major infrastructure spender on road construction, maintenance, and related services. Procurement via own portal and eTenders.
national_portals.update_frequency: Ongoing — multiple active tenders at all times
registration_requirements: CSD registration mandatory
CIDB grade required for construction work (CE class)
SANRAL e-Supplier Development Desk (eSDD) registration available for SMMEs

high_value_for: Veralift Crane Hire (bridge and road construction heavy lift)
potential_for: Veralogix Rentals (plant and equipment hire on road projects)

national_portals.portal_name: PRASA (Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa)
national_portals.description: State entity managing commuter and long-distance passenger rail. Procurement covers rolling stock, infrastructure, station upgrades, security, and ICT.
national_portals.update_frequency: Ongoing — tenders published via PRASA site and eTenders
registration_requirements: CSD registration mandatory
CIDB grade for construction tenders
Sector-specific technical qualifications as specified per tender

national_portals.description: State development finance institution financing and implementing public infrastructure. Issues its own procurement for project management, technical advisory, and construction.
registration_requirements: CSD registration
CIDB grade for construction-related mandates
Professional registrations (ECSA, SACPCMP) for technical advisory

potential_for: Mining Safety Services (safety advisory on DBSA-funded mining infrastructure)

national_portals.description: State water utility supplying bulk water to Gauteng and surrounding areas. Major infrastructure and maintenance spender.
national_portals.update_frequency: Ongoing — multiple tender categories at all times

data_format_assessment.summary: South Africa's tender landscape is fragmented. Only National Treasury eTenders offers a true public API (OCDS standard). All other portals are HTML-scrape or PDF-download only. For a Geologix Vanguard database, a layered collection strategy is recommended.

tier_1_api.description: Direct API integration — highest reliability and lowest maintenance

portals.format: OCDS-compliant JSON (also available as CSV and Excel monthly bulk files)
portals.coverage: All national and most provincial tenders; many municipal and SOE tenders
portals.notes: This single API covers 70%+ of relevant SA public procurement. Build the database on this first.

tier_2_structured_scrape.description: HTML scraping of well-structured portals — medium maintenance

portals.notes: Separate from eTenders; must be scraped independently
eSupplier Portal (esupplierportal.transnet.net) requires login for full detail
Public bids view does not require login

portals.portal: City of Cape Town Tender Portal
